findings.title: Incremental execution/lot prices use cumulative average, corrupting partial-fill cashflow
findings.impact: Execution cash, lot basis and realized-trade PnL; independent close-accounting order-summary PnL can remain correct.
findings.repair: candidate fixed; 211 selected cases pass; no runtime deployment

findings.title: Summary commit precedes execution/lot accounting; retry treats missing accounting as already applied
findings.proof: Injected lot failure after summary commit leaves Order filled10 with zero executions/lots; next same snapshot returns duplicate_or_stale_fill. Handler also swallows exception so queue retry sees success.
findings.impact: Unrecoverable-by-normal-identical-snapshot DB accounting gap, with misleading terminal status.
findings.repair: candidate fixed; 211 selected cases pass; no runtime deployment

findings.title: EOD pending-entry cancellation invokes missing stream method and silently does nothing
findings.proof: Exact EOD source block executed with actual stream class and pending internal UUID: no cancel_order method, zero OrderService cancels. Pending IDs also expire after30ticks independent of broker status.
findings.impact: Previously admitted open limit entries can survive intended EOD cancellation; late fill can carry overnight. No observed production order claimed.
findings.freeze_impact: _live_tick_inner and/or other hashed entry surface; approval required
additional_evidence: _cancel_pending_entry_orders current7905 clears failed cancellations as well as confirmed ones; not a safe EOD drop-in
_stage_expire_cooldowns removes pending IDs on tick TTL, independent of broker terminal status
smallest_approval_scope: retain authoritative pending-entry identity until broker terminal confirmation
replace EOD dead stream cancel call with exact attributed entry cancellation/terminal reconciliation
preserve protective exits and handle filled-during-cancel without claiming flat
required_proof: real tick EOD with actual stream class and mocked broker exact IDs
cancel timeout/partial fill/filled-during-cancel leaves tracking until terminal
stale tick TTL cannot erase still-open broker entry

findings.title: Admin cleanup labels unknown accepted orders expired without broker/outbox proof
findings.proof: Route updates accepted/no broker_id/>1h rows unconditionally; current stream can recover by exact client key despite route doc claiming impossible.
findings.impact: Unknown ambiguous acknowledgement or pending outbox can be represented as expired, including historical UNKNOWN rows. Admin-triggered only.
smallest_approval_scope: make cleanup report unresolved status or reconcile exact original client identity without synthetic expiration
never alter five historical UNKNOWN rows absent authoritative broker evidence
required_proof: admin invocation with accepted/no broker ID/pending outbox cannot label expired
read-only unresolved reporting and exact proven terminal mapping

findings.title: Terminal cancellation/expiry with confirmed partial quantity never creates missing fill accounting
findings.proof: Actual helper(status=cancelled,filled_qty4,avg100) returns non_fill_status; reconnect may only see terminal snapshot.
findings.impact: Missed partial update leaves executions/lots absent even when terminal broker snapshot has authoritative quantity.
findings.repair: candidate fixed; 211 selected cases pass; no runtime deployment

known_residuals: Ambiguous-ACK persistence is correctly lookup-only AFTER marker commit; before-marker crash remains documented distributed boundary, not newly introduced.
Five exact historical unknown rows must remain UNKNOWN; no local cleanup or prior synthetic test can establish their broker outcome.
Close accounting replacement lineage intentionally fails closed and is not treated as safe replacement support.
Recovery inventory is bounded: reconnect100 recent locally updated rows <=1h, startup latest500 broker orders; old or unobserved rows outside inventory are not proven reconciled.
Positions table is a broker-refreshed mirror, separate from atomic execution/lot transaction.
Material same-quantity cash corrections and pre-existing wrong cost basis require explicit reconciliation; no historical rewrite.
SQLite isolation tests prove transactional rollback/idempotent replay, not empirical PostgreSQL concurrency.
further_source_observations_pending: Outbox retries do not revalidate age/current admission; no fresh-intent expiry visible.
Startup cancels all open orders before engine initialization, including possibly protective orders; not modified.
Outbox status ACK can arrive after stream terminal update; generic repository setter has no monotonic guard.
Legacy drawdown cancellation clears failed local tracking; included in pending-attribution frozen scope.

nonclaims: No observed live/paper loss attributed to these defects.
